cases.assertion: input output and cache-read usage use the frozen profile prices
tool-related provider usage is included once in the call total
a profile without a usable price cannot silently pass as zero cost
concurrent calls cannot reserve the same remaining tenant allowance
one tenant reaching its ceiling does not consume another tenant allowance
tenant_budget_exceeded is final for the request and is not automatically retried
an in-flight call settles final usage and records any non-zero difference
task admission and gateway checks use one authoritative tenant meter
cost errors expose only bounded tenant-period counters and no provider secret
model nodes receive the same ordered Context Builder sources as the approved path
tool loop and model node share one assembled context without duplicate system or tool text
source budgets and truncation are deterministic and replayable
requests without the new context fields keep the existing minimum context
obj URI from another tenant or an unregistered prefix is denied
object reads enforce maximum bytes tokens and allowed content types
missing or expired objects return a bounded not-found result without cross-tenant fallback
temporary ObjectStore failure remains distinct from missing or unauthorized data
retrieved content and errors do not echo secret values into events logs or traces
implementation reuses existing meter Task State and ObjectStore lifecycles
